notes:
Account summary: LyraSecure ContactFlow is a fintech customer-facing platform (payments and statements) with strict PCI and PHI adjacency concerns — support org handles payment disputes and sensitive customer info. Primary goal: reduce AHT and improve agent accuracy via real-time agent-assist + automated ticket summarization; live tool-calls to backend CRMs and payments ledger must be audited. They require VPC/private deployment, customer-managed KMS, and audit log forwarding to their SIEM. Key SLAs: 95th pct latency <120ms for token streaming in agent-assist; sustain 5x baseline concurrency during billing cycle spikes with graceful degradation to lower-cost model variants.

Quotes & paraphrases: "We cannot have PII/PCI tokens leave our VPC unencrypted"; "audit trail retention 5+ years, full immutable logs for any tool-call".

POC scope: - Agent assist (context window pinned to last 90 days of CS interactions) - Ticket summarization + suggested disposition codes - Tool-calling orchestration (CRM update, refund trigger) with built-in confirm flows.

Security asks: must support SSO/SAML, detailed audit logs (who/what/when), retention controls (immutable retention 5 years, legal hold), KMS/HSM integration, and optional air-gapped on-prem for payment processing lane. Legal/procurement requested SOC2 Type II evidence + recent pentest before signature.

Sales notes: AE owns commercial; SE (Marco) owns POC infra. Procurement expects a standard enterprise contract + addendum for PCI handling. Expect procurement to push for liability carveouts; timeline aggressive — target close 2026-06.

Sticking points: SOC2 gap for dedicated infra, pen-test timeline, exact egress rules and whether tokenized payment flows can be proxied through Redwood or must remain customer-side.
